subject: physics
content: For extrinsic semiconductors; when doping level is increased;

options.content: Fermi-level of both p-type and n-type semiconductors will go upward for T > T<sub>F</sub>K and downward for T < T<sub>F</sub>K, where T<sub>F</sub> is Fermi temperature.
Fermi-level of p-type semiconductor will go upward and Fermi-level of n-type semiconductors will go downward
Fermi-level of p and n-type semiconductors will not be affected.
Fermi-level of p-type semiconductors will go downward and Fermi-level of n-type semiconductor will go upward.

explanation:
In n-type semiconductor pentavalent impurity is added. Each pentavalent impurity donates a free electron. So the Fermi-level of n-type semiconductor will go upward.

And In p-type semiconductor trivalent impurity is added. Each trivalent impurity creates a hole in the valence band. So the Fermi-level of p-type semiconductor will go downward.
